title: Spex Workspace Config
description: Workspace configuration (spex.yaml): the project and the workspace repositories that spex manages together.

cli_version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) of the spex CLI that wrote this config. spex warns on a mismatch with the installed CLI; run `spex update` to sync.

description.description: Optional summary of what the project is and does.

repositories.description: Workspace repositories that spex manages for this project.

repository_name.description: Full kebab-case name of the repository, `<project-name>-<repository-short-name>` (for example `pepperoni-pizza-api`). Matches the repository directory name per TECH-NAMING-CONVENTION.

repository_short_name.description: Kebab-case name of the repository excluding the project name (for example `api`). Used to derive cross-cutting identifiers in TECH-NAMING-CONVENTION.

description.description: Optional summary of what the repository is and does.

path.description: Path to the repository, relative to the spex directory.

contracts.description: Machine-readable interface contracts this repository owns, copied into the spex repository's `contracts/` folder. Each entry points at a contract file and summarizes it.

tech_specs.description: TECH spec IDs that apply to this repository.

checks_additional.description: Full checks that run for this repository in addition to the checks it inherits from its tech_specs. Each entry is a complete check plus the `spec` it belongs to (one of the repository's tech_specs). Script paths resolve in the spex directory.

checks_override.description: Partial patches applied to inherited checks. Each entry names the inherited check by `spec` + `name`; any other field present overrides that field, and the merged check runs instead of the inherited one. Set `disable: true` to turn the inherited check off entirely. A `script` set here resolves in the spex directory, the same as the inherited script.

checks_preexisting_errors.description: Baseline of pre-existing `error`-severity findings to suppress for this repository, so a check can be enforced going forward without first fixing every existing violation. Each entry names the check by `spec` + `check`; an `error` finding from that check is dropped when its location file is listed in `files` (or always, when `files` is omitted or empty). New errors in other files still surface, and `warn`-severity findings are never affected.

contract.description: A machine-readable interface contract (OpenAPI, proto, GraphQL SDL, AsyncAPI) owned by a repository and stored in the spex repository's `contracts/` folder.

path.description: Path to the contract file inside the spex repository, relative to the spex directory (for example `contracts/api.openapi.yaml`).

description.description: Short summary of what the contract covers (for example `admin rest openapi spec`).

preexisting_error.description: A baseline entry that suppresses pre-existing `error`-severity findings for one check.

spec.description: Tech spec ID of the check whose pre-existing errors are baselined. Must be one of the repository's tech_specs.

check.description: Name of the check whose pre-existing errors are baselined.

files.description: Repository-relative files whose pre-existing errors are suppressed. Omit or leave empty to suppress the whole check. A regexp finding's `file:line` location is matched on its file part.

check_override.description: A partial patch for an inherited check. `spec` + `name` identify the target; every other field overrides the inherited check when present.

spec.description: Tech spec ID of the inherited check to override. Must be one of the repository's tech_specs.

name.description: Name of the inherited check to override.

disable.description: When `true`, the inherited check is disabled entirely and never runs. Other override fields are ignored.

pattern.description: Overrides the inherited check's regexp or glob pattern.

negate.description: Overrides the inherited check's negate flag.

script.description: Overrides the inherited check's script filename. When set, it resolves in the spex directory at `scripts/<spec-id>/<script>`.

run.description: Overrides the inherited script check's invocation granularity.

include.description: Overrides the inherited check's include globs.

exclude.description: Overrides the inherited check's exclude globs.

contracts.description: REST OpenAPI spec for the orders API.

repositories.description: React web client that lets customers place orders.

checks_additional.name: readme-has-title
checks_additional.description: The frontend README must start with a top-level Markdown title.
